lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb4Ag4Bi4 (reduced formula YbAgBi) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 38), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: Ag and Bi each have 8 Yb neighbors, while Yb has 8 neighbors (4 Ag, 4 Bi), with distances near 3.34–3.37 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 8-vertex Yb, Ag, and Bi coordination polyhedra.
